title: Low-pass filter
summary: Cut everything above a frequency: hiss, whistles and high-frequency interference above the voice. The magnitude of a Butterworth filter, −3 dB at the cutoff, applied with zero phase.

params.title: Cutoff
params.help: The level is 3 dB down here and falls by the slope above it. Must be below half the sample rate.

params.title: Deepest cut
params.help: The cut never goes deeper than this; 0 leaves the audio untouched.
